title: VideoCreateRequest
description: The request that adds a video to a project's queue.

input_path.description: Absolute path to the source video.

name.description: Optional display name; defaults to the input's file name.

output_path.description:
Absolute path the concatenated output is written to.

When absent or empty, the service derives it from the project's General output
policy. A client may still send an explicit path to override the default once.
